title: Sol-Ark Modbus – Operational Console

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id =~ /^${entity_prefix}(${inverter:raw})_daily_pv_energy$/)
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum(column: "_value")

import "timezone"

import "date"
import "strings"

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 7d, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id =~ /^${entity_prefix}(${inverter:raw})_(load_total_power|grid_total_power|pv_total_power)$/)
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    entity_id:
      if strings.hasSuffix(v: r.entity_id, suffix: "load_total_power") then "${entity_prefix}system_load_total_power"
      else if strings.hasSuffix(v: r.entity_id, suffix: "grid_total_power") then "${entity_prefix}system_grid_total_power"
      else "${entity_prefix}system_pv_total_power"
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "entity_id"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= v.timeRangeStart)

import "date"

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 7d, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id =~ /^${entity_prefix}(${inverter:raw})_battery_power$/)
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: -1.0 * float(v: r._value), entity_id: "${entity_prefix}system_battery_power" }))
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "entity_id"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= v.timeRangeStart)

import "date"

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 7d, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    if "${inverter:raw}" == "1|2" then
      r.entity_id == "${shunt_soc_entity}"
    else
      r.entity_id == "${entity_prefix}${inverter}_battery_state_of_charge"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with entity_id: "${entity_prefix}system_battery_state_of_charge" }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(column: "_value", usePrevious: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= v.timeRangeStart)

description: Operational console with System, inverter 1, and inverter 2 views; System sums inverter-local power, current, and energy while retaining representative voltage and external-shunt SOC.
